name: Logos
description: Company or product logos, typically consisting of flat colors, clean geometric shapes, and clear typography. Usually requires high fidelity preservation of sharp corners.

name: Icons
description: Small, simplified symbols used for UI/UX. Often monochromatic or using very few colors. Crucial to preserve symmetry and minimal path count.

name: Illustrations
description: Digital drawings or vector-style art exported as raster. Features moderate color palettes, distinct regions, but more complexity than logos.

name: Complex Artwork
description: Highly detailed digital art or paintings with gradients, many colors, and intricate details. Stresses the clustering and hierarchical layers of the vectorizer.

name: Photographs
description: Real-world camera captures with noise, continuous gradients, and millions of colors. Extremely challenging for vectorization; requires heavy quantization.

name: Binary Graphics
description: Strictly black and white images (e.g., scanned documents, line art, QR codes, barcodes). Requires thresholding and crisp edge tracing.
